name: desk-buddy
description: A 3D character inside VS Code that reminds you to drink water and finish your tasks.

deskBuddy.userName.description: Name the character uses when talking to you.

deskBuddy.waterEveryMinutes.description: Minutes between water reminders. 0 (the default) turns them off, so only your own tasks pop up.

deskBuddy.autoReveal.description: Open the Desk Buddy view automatically when a reminder is due. If off (or if it can't open), a normal VS Code notification is used.

deskBuddy.display.description: overlay: the character appears on its own at the left edge of your screen and nothing opens in VS Code (needs Electron). sidebar: reminders open the Desk Buddy side bar.

deskBuddy.overlayElectronPath.description: Path to electron.exe used for the overlay. Leave empty to detect one in your workspace's node_modules or a global npm install.

deskBuddy.closeAfterAnswer.description: Close the side bar again after you answer a reminder that opened it, so the character just visits and leaves.

deskBuddy.sound.description: Play a soft chime with each reminder.
